text:
alex: FYI postmortem notes are in the doc, but we need a short plan for SLO changes and owners. Latency tail is recurring for small requests (p95 fine, p99 spikes). Summary: memory pressure + slow model swap looks like the root cause.
maya: +1. Do we want to adjust the SLO (p99 -> 500ms) or try remediation first?
sam: I think we should be conservative: short-term SLO reprioritize + hardening rollout for the swap path. If we change SLO, we need customer comms and billing impact analysis.
jeremy: Proposal: 1) Action: add a p99.9 alert (owner: maya) due EOD Thu; 2) Action: rollback-safe model pinning for small-req routes (owner: sam) staging by Mon; 3) Action: dashboard with request size buckets and KV cache hit rate (owner: alex + natalie) due next Wed.
maya: I'll take the alert. Suggest threshold 750ms for now, with a 5m window. I'll add mute rules for deploy noise.
oncall-bot: Incident #INC-1443 acknowledged by rotation: oncall=jeremy, severity=sev2, start=2345678899
jeremy: I'll coordinate the rollback-safe model pinning PR. ETA Monday for staging test; if green, prod can roll under canary. Sam to own the rollback playbook doc.
sam: I'll open the PR and link the playbook. Quick note: need an infra flag to disable swap-on-demand — infra ticket owned by natalie.
natalie: Created INF-872 and assigned to myself. Timeline: review Wed, implementation Thu if no blockers.
alex: For dashboards, let's add a synthetic small-req job (10 req/s) and plot p50/p95/p99/p99.9, plus KV hit rate. Put a panel showing deploys overlaid. I'll prototype panels today.
maya: About SLO change: ops suggestion is to keep SLO until we've completed 2 mitigations and 2 clean deploy windows. If repeat happens, we do an emergency SLO backfill and customer notice.
jeremy: Agree. Also propose a temporary error-budget policy: auto-throttle lower-priority background work when error-budget burn exceeds 30% in a 24h window. Owner: alex to draft policy.
alex: Will draft the policy doc and a short runbook for auto-throttle. Target: Fri COB for PR.
sam: Can we add an automated job to sample traces for high-latency p99 requests (owner: maya) — helps validate root cause.
maya: Yep, will add tail-sampling to tracing config. ETA Thu.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem assigned to alex, sam, maya — due 2345679000
jeremy: OK to summarize owners and dates: maya(alert+p99.9 alert + trace sampling) due Thu; natalie(infra flag INF-872) review Wed/implementation Thu; sam(rollback playbook + PR) staging Mon; alex(dashboards + auto-throttle policy) Fri; follow-up check-in next Tue 10am.
natalie: I'll also add a perf-test that simulates KV thrash to reproduce memory pressure. Plan: small cluster test Tue.
alex: I'll create the follow-up ticket list and Slack reminder for Tue 10am. If anyone needs to swap owners ping here. :thumbsup:
jeremy: Thanks all. Let's keep this thread for quick status updates only. If you hit a blocker, open a ticket and ping #eng-oncall.
sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/3897 — includes test plan.
maya: Alert added: https://grafana/redwood/d/alerts/alert-44 — starting to monitor.
alex: Dashboard prototype pushed to grafana (draft link) — calling out p99.9 panel specially.
jeremy: Closing loop: no SLO change for now. Revisit Tue after the mitigations and perf test. If we still see repeat, we'll prepare a customer-facing note and SLO adjustment.
maya: noted.
jeremy: thanks everyone :rocket:
